original_tasks.title: Project scaffold, models, errors and add()
original_tasks.description: Create package `todo` with TodoItem dataclass, TodoError/ItemNotFoundError/ValidationError, TodoList with internal store and id counter, add(), and an internal _get(item_id) helper that validates id type (non-int/bool -> ValidationError) and raises ItemNotFoundError with the id in the message. Add tests/test_add.py and tests for _get behaviour via public API where possible.
acceptance_criteria: add returns TodoItem with defaults and stripped text
ids start at 1, increment, and are not reused after deletion (tested once delete exists, or via counter)
add with '', '   ', or non-str raises ValidationError and creates nothing
ItemNotFoundError and ValidationError importable from todo; hierarchy as described

original_tasks.title: list_items()
original_tasks.description: Implement list_items() returning a copy list of items in insertion order. Tests in tests/test_list.py.
acceptance_criteria: mutating returned list does not affect the store

original_tasks.title: complete()
acceptance_criteria: marks item complete and returns it
unknown id raises ItemNotFoundError mentioning the id

original_tasks.title: delete()
acceptance_criteria: new add after delete gets a fresh, never-reused id

original_tasks.title: rename()
original_tasks.description: Implement rename(item_id, new_text). Tests in tests/test_rename.py.
acceptance_criteria: text updated and stripped, item returned
empty/whitespace/non-str raises ValidationError and text unchanged

original_tasks.title: set_due_date()
original_tasks.description: Implement set_due_date(item_id, due) accepting date, ISO string, or None. Tests in tests/test_due_date.py.

original_tasks.title: set_priority()
original_tasks.description: Implement set_priority(item_id, priority). Tests in tests/test_priority.py.
acceptance_criteria: 'urgent', '', None, 'HIGH' raise ValidationError and priority unchanged

original_tasks.title: filter_by_status()
acceptance_criteria: results in id order; empty list if none

original_tasks.title: search()
original_tasks.description: Implement search(query) case-insensitive substring match. Tests in tests/test_search.py.
acceptance_criteria: case-insensitive substring match returns matching items in id order

original_tasks.title: export_json()
original_tasks.description: Implement export_json() returning JSON string of list of item dicts. Tests in tests/test_export.py.
acceptance_criteria: due_date serialized as ISO string or null

original_tasks.title: import_json() happy path and round trip
original_tasks.description: Implement import_json(data) for valid input with defaults for optional fields, preserving ids, updating the id counter, returning count. Tests in tests/test_import.py.
acceptance_criteria: ids preserved and later add() gets id greater than max existing
export -> import into a new TodoList yields equal items

original_tasks.title: import_json() validation and atomicity
original_tasks.description: Add full validation to import_json: validate everything before mutating the store. Tests in tests/test_import_validation.py.
acceptance_criteria: invalid JSON, non-list top level, non-object items raise ValidationError
empty text, bad priority, non-bool complete, bad due_date, non-int/bool id, missing id or text raise ValidationError
duplicate ids within the data or against existing items raise ValidationError
after any failure the list is unchanged (atomic)
